title: The rental terms, the auto-debit and case-move operation names, the arrears follow-up owner and threshold, the ATS interface and the step name are not specified in the source documents
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E4-033); Recovery Workbench FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 (A2.24.2, A2.24.3.1, A2.24.3.2); Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (T3.1, T3.2, T5.1, appendix T-A.1); Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 (R-DIS-25, R-DIS-63); Recovery Workbench FSD P8 Payments and posting v3 (A2.9); Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3; Ownership Map v1
description: (a) the rental terms have no physical column set: TSD S5 T3.1 gives `asset` DF-COL-028 to DF-COL-042 with no rental field and `asset_sale` DF-SAL-009 to DF-SAL-019 with sale fields only, while the FSD A2.24.3.2 field catalog names v_ace_npa_asset columns only, so no source says whether the rental terms extend `asset` or `asset_sale`; (b) the rwb-payment auto-debit request has no operation name in the Ownership Map, in TSD S5 appendix T-A.1 or in API Specification v4; (c) the rwb-case case-move answer has no published operation name; (d) the arrears follow-up of the legacy Then has no named owner for a third-party rental, and R-DIS-63 names a rental_arrears threshold that no source gives a value; (e) ATS is named by the R-DIS-25 Systems cell, by FSD S5 A2.24.2 and by the Epic 4 row, while TSD S5 T5.1 lists INT-11 SVAF, INT-12 AMIS, INT-13 RPS and INT-27 HOME.SCB and no ATS interface; (f) the activity name of the step is fixed by no source.
evidence: TSD S5 v2 T3.1 (asset DF-COL-028 to DF-COL-042 and asset_sale DF-SAL-009 to DF-SAL-019, no rental column), T3.2 (LOV-HOLDING with RENTED), T5.1 (four interfaces, no ATS), appendix T-A.1 (API-S5-001 to API-S5-005, no rental or debit path); FSD S5 v3 A2.24.2 (Integration points AMIS, ATS), A2.24.3.1 (R-DIS-25, VR-S5-024-1, BR-S5-024), A2.24.3.2 (v_ace_npa_asset fields only); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIS-25 and R-DIS-63; FSD P8 v3 A2.9 (the rental auto-debit, the receipt and the arrears follow-up are P8 FEAT-PAY-09); Epic 4 row FEAT-AST-24 (AMIS, ATS).
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-asset, solution architect, and the owners of rwb-payment and rwb-case
proposed: Read the rental terms as an additive column set on `asset` created by the DB story of this service; read the auto-debit request and the case-move answer as consumed rows whose names are pending; read the arrears follow-up as rwb-payment's with the notice requested from rwb-comms and no threshold value written; track ATS as an external system with no build and no interface; name the activity rentHeldAsset.

title: The legacy Data, Endpoints and Screen tables name views, tables, an operation and a screen state that this slice does not read, call or show
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md (RWB-E4-033); Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (T3.1, T3.2); Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 (slides 19, 29, 37, 41 and 45); Ownership Map v1
description: The legacy Data table names v_ace_customer, v_ace_account, v_ace_npa_asset, recovery_case, decision_log_entry and rule_row; in the target every v_ace_* view belongs to P1 and is read only by rwb-source-data (DP-05), recovery_case belongs to P3 and decision_log_entry and rule_row to P7, so this service may read none of them. The legacy Endpoints table names GET /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId}, which the business-key path supersedes, and POST /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId}/valuations, which is rwb-valuation's under ASM-A6-api-6; the rental step calls neither. The legacy Screen and states table lists four states of SCR-22 and no rented state, while LOV-HOLDING carries RENTED, so the state the rental produces has no row in the legacy list.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-033 Data, Endpoints and Screen and states tables; TSD S5 v2 T3.1 and T3.2 (LOV-HOLDING with RENTED); Ownership Map v1 (recovery_case, task and timer owner P3; decision_log_entry, rule_row and approval owner P7; POST /assets/{assetId}/valuations owner S1 under ASM-A6-api-6; the two v2 asset paths superseded under ASM-A6-api-15); Architecture v5 slides 19, 29, 37, 41 and 45 (only rwb-source-data reads the recovery.v_ace_* views).
area: Data boundary, endpoint ownership and screen states
proposed: Read the rental step from the service's own `asset` row and the rwb-case contract only; keep the two reads on the business-key path; show RENTED inside the held state of SCR-22 rather than as a fifth legacy state; record the legacy rows as corrected rather than lost.

title: The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice
source: Recovery Workbench FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 (Requirements served); Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Epics 3 to 8 v1 (BR-030); Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Program v4 (REQ-S5-010); plan split_plan.json
description: The FSD S5 requirements served table and BR-030 of the Epics 3 to 8 BRD carry REQ-S5-010 for a recorded rental approval, and the split plan carries no requirement row for RWB-S5-E4033; the story cites the requirement from the FSD and names the absence rather than leaving the table empty.
evidence: FSD S5 v3 Requirements served (REQ-S5-010, Must, E4); Recovery Workbench Business Requirements Epics 3 to 8 v1 BR-030 (third-party rental carries its recorded approval, REQ-S5-010 and FEAT-AST-24); Business Requirements Program v4 REQ-S5-010; split plan with no requirement row for the slice.
proposed: Cite REQ-S5-010 from the FSD and BR-030, keep the plan unchanged, and let step D1 number the row; no story content changes.

title: The rental element, the consumed operation names and the ATS interface are not specified in the source documents
source: Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (T3.1, T3.2, T5.1, appendix T-A.1); Recovery Workbench FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 (A2.24.3.2); Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 (/assets, /assets/{assetKey}); Recovery Workbench Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 (R-DIS-25); Ownership Map v1; Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 (slides 19 and 41)
description: (a) no source gives the property names, types or required flags of a rental element for the reads, because TSD S5 T3.1 has no rental column on `asset` or on `asset_sale`; (b) the rwb-payment auto-debit request, the rwb-case case-move answer and the rwb-source-data asset read have no published operation name or request shape in the Ownership Map, in TSD S5 appendix T-A.1 or in API Specification v4; (c) ATS has no interface specification and no row in TSD S5 T5.1, so no operation, topic or fake of it can be declared; (d) no source states whether the rental terms are answered on the single read only or on the list as well.
evidence: TSD S5 v2 T3.1 (no rental column), T3.2 (LOV-HOLDING), T5.1 (INT-11, INT-12, INT-13 and INT-27, no ATS), appendix T-A.1 (API-S5-001 to API-S5-005); FSD S5 v3 A2.24.3.2; API Specification v4 /assets and /assets/{assetKey} (operationIds getAssets and getAssetsAssetkey); Ownership Map v1; Architecture v5 slides 19 and 41.
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-asset and solution architect, with the owners of rwb-payment, rwb-case and rwb-source-data
proposed: Declare the Rental element additively with eight properties and two required flags, declare the three consumed rows with placeholders, declare the notice request of rwb-comms, and declare no ATS operation and no fake for it.

title: The read path carries the ACE asset business key while the asset table is keyed by a record identifier
source: Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 (/assets/{assetKey}); Recovery Workbench FSD S5 Assets and auction v3 (A2.24.3.2); Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (T3.1, T3.3); Ownership Map v1 (GET /assets/{assetId}, POST /assets/{assetId}/listings)
description: API Specification v4 declares /assets/{assetKey} with the parameter described as the ACE asset_key of the held asset in v_ace_npa_asset, and FSD S5 A2.24.3.2 says listing and asset_sale link to the ACE asset_key by key with no foreign key; TSD S5 T3.1 keys `asset` by the uuid id (DF-COL-028), carries asset_ref varchar(20) (DF-COL-031) and no asset_key column, and keys `listing` and `asset_sale` by an asset_id uuid (DF-SAL-002, DF-SAL-010). The Ownership Map row GET /assets/{assetId} is superseded by the business-key path under ASM-A6-api-15 and no source reconciles the two keys, so the path parameter has no column to resolve against.
evidence: API Specification v4 /assets/{assetKey} (parameter assetKey, the ACE asset_key of the held asset); FSD S5 v3 A2.24.3.2 (v_ace_npa_asset.asset_key, no foreign key); TSD S5 v2 T3.1 (asset id uuid and asset_ref varchar(20), listing asset_id, asset_sale asset_id) and T3.3 (relationships inside the module only); Ownership Map v1 rows GET /assets/{assetId} and POST /assets/{assetId}/listings with ASM-A6-api-15.
proposed: Read the path parameter as the ACE asset business key of the held asset and let the app story resolve it on its own row; keep the uuid id as the internal record key; record the correction of the Ownership Map row and the TSD column for the solution architect.

title: No approval record, deprecation window or fake retention is stated for the contract baseline
source: Root AGENTS.md rules 1 to 14 and the D-RCV-60 overlay; 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md (R1 U8, R9); Recovery Workbench Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 (slide 42); Recovery Workbench TSD S5 Assets and auction v2 (appendix T-B)
description: The baseline sits in Draft (realignment v1) with no approval record and the run proceeds under the D-RCV-60 overlay, and no source fixes the deprecation window of a published field or the retention period of a contract fake, so both stay open for the solution architect while the baseline unblocks Day-1 work.
evidence: Root AGENTS.md rules 1 to 14 and the D-RCV-60 overlay (no human approval in this run; record an assumption and continue in Draft); Template and Rules v1 R1 U8 and R9 (no verification stop, gaps and assumptions); Architecture v5 slide 42 (BACKWARD compatibility and versioned schemas); TSD S5 v2 appendix T-B.
proposed: Baseline in Draft, record the missing approval and the open deprecation window and fake retention as assumptions, cite REQ-S5-010 from the FSD, and collect the consumer sign-off when it is available.
